_comment: Generation hooks for tools/sound_gen.py and the Sound Studio. Keys never go in this file:
reference them as ${ENV_VAR} and export them in the shell that starts the studio.
claude   Claude writes a score (mm-score/1); the studio turns it into .mid and renders it.
http     POST a JSON body, get audio bytes back. Placeholders: {prompt} {text} {seconds}
{seconds_int} {ms} {title} {id} {voice_id} {model}. A value that is exactly one
numeric placeholder ("{ms}") is sent as a number.
command  Run anything. Placeholders: {prompt_file} {out} {seconds} {id} {title}. The command
must write {out}. With "makes": "score" it must write an mm-score/1 JSON instead
and the studio renders it (use this to plug in another LLM as the composer).
Renderers turn a score / .mid into audio: builtin (numpy synth), fluidsynth (needs a SoundFont),
or a command with placeholders {midi} {sketch} {out} {seconds} {title}. {sketch} is the builtin
render as a WAV, for audio-to-audio models that realise a sketch. The command must write {out} as WAV.
Set "enabled": false to hide a hook without deleting it.

claude_score.label: Claude → MIDI → render
claude_score.note: Needs `pip install anthropic` and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or an `ant auth login` profile).
